dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: I've gotten all the evidence I need... Academic world, prepare to be blown away!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you writing a thesis?

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: Huh? You're interested in research, too, young'un?

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: In that case, I'll lay out the basic outline. I don't suppose you've read my acclaimed work, "Criticism on Pseudo Remuria History - Starting from the Nonexistence of Remus" by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: My current thesis follows similar threads. I want to prove to the academic establishment that this world is a flat surface floating through the void, and that its edge is right here, in Nod-Krai!

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: Working from that basis, I further hypothesize that what we know as Snezhnaya is a complete and utter fiction. It does not, nor has it ever, existed—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I've heard enough.

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: Hmph, be on your way then. You'll understand once you read my thesis.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you mean, "Snezhnaya is a fiction"?

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: Simple, since Nod-Krai is at the edge of the world, then no country could possibly exist beyond it.

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: Think about it — a nation of ice and snow in the north? A land where the fae roam free? It sounds a lot like Remuria, don't you think? Just the fanciful ramblings of bards and storytellers.

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: Not a single record in the House of Daena that describes Snezhnaya either comes from Snezhnaya or was written by a Snezhnayan. What does that tell you?

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: It's obvious, isn't it — there is no Snezhnaya! It doesn't exist. It's a creation of vagrants and fugitives from Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But Snezhnayans are everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: *sigh* You're still not getting it — these "Snezhnayans" are just people from Nod-Krai.

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: They don't have any history of their own, so they've invented this grand, advanced civilization called Snezhnaya to cover up their barren past.

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: Forget it. You'll understand once you read my thesis.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But the Fatui are everywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: Then let me ask you this — have you seen Snezhnaya for yourself? Or have you only heard about it from people hiding behind masks?

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: These so-called "Fatui" are just wandering mercenaries, no different from the Eremites. They're being paid by some unknown power to spread the lie of Snezhnaya's existence!

dialogues.speaker: Harshin
dialogues.text: *sigh* Forget it. You'll understand once you read my thesis.
